November 28, 2026: CardPointers is on sale for Black Friday right now. That brings the annual subscription to $50 per year (Reg. $100) and the lifetime purchase to $150 (Reg. $300).

I’ve covered CardPointers before at 9to5Mac, highlighting how helpful it is for maximizing credit card rewards and offers. Now, CardPointers 8 has been released with Siri AI integration, new widgets, and much more.

The premise of CardPointers is simple: it helps you take full advantage of your credit card rewards. That includes credit card offers, monthly credits, sign-up bonuses, and more. It also helps you track things like annual fee renewal dates.

One of the biggest changes in CardPointers 8 for long-time users is support for in-app offer syncing:

Connect your accounts (it even supports multiple accounts per bank), and let CardPointers automatically activate every offer on your Amex, Chase, Citi, Bank of America, US Bank, and Wells Fargo cards.

CardPointers can now automatically sync your offers every night while you sleep, so you’ll never miss an offer again.

And with even more offers, it’s important to help you find the best ones, so you can now filter and sort your offers by grade to find the biggest moneymakers.

Other new features in CardPointers 8:

  • Siri AI integration: 36 new App Intents and on-screen awareness to find, redeem, update, and share offers.
  • Visual Intelligence: Point your iPhone at a storefront, product, screenshot, or receipt, and CardPointers will tell you which card to use as well as relevant offers.
  • Eight new extra-large widgets for your iPhone Home Screen.
  • Track your savings with a new Offer Savings dashboard.
  • Automate actions on recurring standard offers.
  • Create custom offers with AI and set them to repeat.
  • Get AI summaries of offer terms.
  • New Mac menu bar app.

9to5Mac readers can save 50% on CardPointers and get a $200 Savings Card as a sign-up bonus. I’ve used the app for a long time, and it’s a great example of an app that respects Apple’s platforms and is always there with support for new platform features.
